description_zh: 事故地点为 Capp St 与 24th St 的平面十字交叉口，Capp St 南北双向行驶、24th St 东西向通行，故取 cross_intersection；事实未给出车道数与中心线类型，按城市道路默认双向各一条、中心线可跨越。

source_snippets: ADDRESS/LOCATION OF ACCIDENT On Capp Street at 24th Street
stopped at a red traffic light on northbound Capp St at the intersection with 24th St in San Francisco
an SUV (Vehicle 2), heading southbound on Capp St, failed to stop for the red traffic light and entered the intersection
a passenger car (Vehicle 3) that was traveling eastbound on 24th Street
evidence.reason: 事故地点明确为 Capp St 与 24th St 的平面交叉口（'at the intersection with 24th St'，且南北向 Capp St 与东西向 24th St 均有车辆通行），属四向十字路口，因此 topology 选 cross_intersection（路口已隐含所有合法转向，不需另列机动）。Capp St 同时存在北向与南向车流，说明双向行驶，故 lanes.backward 不为 0，取默认双向各一条。事实未提及车道数或中心线虚实，type 默认 town、center_line 默认 broken。
